---
name: static-site-change
description: Use when implementing a focused visual, copy, or asset change in the Lilo static storefront.
---

# Static Site Change

1. Search for the exact text, selector, asset reference, or nearby component that owns the requested behavior.
2. Edit only that surface and preserve unrelated user changes.
3. Prefer narrow searches and reads; do not dump the full HTML or enumerate unrelated images.
4. Validate the edited content, then reload the local page for visible UI changes when practical.
5. Report the changed area and any verification limitation in one concise summary.
